title: Community post (2 years ago, approx date)
summary: Announces weekly Saturday Q&A streams with rotating themes and lays out chat rules: no politics, no doxing, no badmouthing or natty-gossip about other fitness influencers.
claims: He started weekly Saturday Q&A streams (2-5PM EST) because live Q&A allows follow-up questions and interaction, a format that had disappeared from the channel
Stream rule: discuss concepts, not people; no badmouthing other fitness influencers and no 'this guy isn't natty' gossip
He considers most fitness influencers idiots but refuses to discuss them by name on stream
Mocking or funny-insulting the streamer is allowed, especially jokes about French people; politics is banned
